summary.text: Megan Hunt is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 8, and was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Megan Hunt's occupation as owner and founder of FiveNine and Ceremony, founder and vice president of Safe Space Nebraska, and co-founder of Majorette.

paragraphs.text: Megan Hunt was born on May 9, 1986, in Blair.
Megan Hunt graduated from Blair High School in 2004 and earned a B.A. in intercultural communication and German from Dana College in 2008.
Megan Hunt has served on the board of Friends of Planned Parenthood of the Heartland since 2015 and as a trustee of the Business Ethics Alliance since 2014.
